description: Positive control for the AC-PL1 right-sized work-item schema. The nine factors, an independently verifiable outcome and a named-human approval for a material scope change are required. No numeric file, line or criterion threshold is part of the rule.

work_item.outcome: Right-sized planning, one canonical delegation packet and deterministic ownership and handover cases

factors.cohesion: Coordination and ownership are one contract; evidence and reconciliation stay in WI-EV.
factors.dependencies: WI-EV supplies the report schema; WI-CI later supplies the required CI evidence.
factors.complexity: Three focused work items avoid nine fixture migrations and repeated review points.
factors.architectural_impact: Amends the unmerged ADR-0002 workflow proposal; no accepted baseline change.
factors.side_effects: New validator guards and fixtures; no production code and no permission change.
factors.testability: Deterministic offline fixtures prove every new guard with in-memory mutations.
factors.agent_context: One packet per work item keeps the context focused and reconstructable.
factors.coordination_overhead: One serial mutation path with three review points instead of nine.
factors.ai_human_review_effort: Focused AI review and testing per item, then one integrated human review.
